title: Fine Tuning Vs Rag
definition: The separation of concerns between teaching a model how to speak (fine-tuning) and teaching a model what to say (RAG).

difficulty_levels.beginner: Fine-tuning teaches an AI model how to talk, while RAG teaches an AI model what to say. This separation allows for more focused and efficient training.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The distinction between using fine-tuning for developing a model's conversational style and using RAG for providing the model with factual knowledge.
difficulty_levels.expert: A novel approach to AI training that separates the process of teaching a model how to speak (fine-tuning) and what to say (RAG), improving the model's overall performance and stability.

extra_fields.insight: The realization that separating fine-tuning and RAG leads to more effective AI training.
